core_obligations: Choose representatives (proof lines 8886-8891): let I^bullet be a K-injective complex representing M and L^bullet a K-flat complex representing L; then the internal hom complex is K-injective by the flat-into-injective lemma.

Compute (proof lines 8892-8893): because that complex is K-injective, its cohomology over an object U may be computed by taking sections over U, and the identification of the resulting groups with the derived Hom groups is the second cited lemma; the global statement is the case U = the final object.
proof_roadmap: Represent the two objects by a K-injective and a K-flat complex and use the flat-into-injective lemma.
Take sections over U and apply the identification of the zeroth cohomology with derived Hom.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies H^0 of the derived internal hom with Hom in the derived category, over any object and over the site (statement lines 8873-8883). The proof (proof lines 8885-8893) chooses a K-injective and a K-flat representative, uses that the internal hom from a K-flat into a K-injective complex is K-injective, and applies the identification of its zeroth cohomology with derived Hom. H2: one choice of representatives plus one identification.
